svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 7 — Page 12 — "Inside the Mechanism" — Section 3 (Heist Conclusion) opens
svg.desc: Page 12: 4 panels in 3 tiers (full / half-half / full widescreen). Section 3 opens. Wren at the lighthouse mechanism level inspecting her route, looking up through brass gears toward the Fresnel lens above. Profile inspection of the replacement lens — copper-gold holographic edges glowing where the calibration is etched. Outside on the gallery, Jink loose and grinning, the wind in their hair, alive at the edge of the world. Then the proximity threat: looking down through the iron grating, the keeper's boots inches above Wren — one layer of iron between them.
